title: Steamed Broccoli with Malaysian Sauce
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that combines the health benefits of steamed broccoli with the rich flavors of a Malaysian-inspired sauce.
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan with water and bring to a boil.
Add the broccoli to the saucepan and steam for 3-5 minutes or until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, lime juice, honey, ginger, and garlic.
Pour the sauce over the steamed broccoli and toss to coat.
Serve immediately and garnish with sesame seeds if desired.
